main_text.l: tissimus filius, & spei dum vixit ma-
ante annos ferè quatuor in urbe
quæ sibi quotidie homines aulici pro Romana Reli-
gione contra reformatam obiectarent, referebat eos in
Doctorum consensu solitos fuisse gloriari, ita ut nihil
frequentius, aut procacius quàm hæc nomina iactarent.
Ac tametsi satis ipse per se intelligeret quàm futilis esset
iliiusmodi obiectio, testabatur tamen gratissimum sibi
fore, si in sui gratiam hoc argumentum paulò accuratius
ac penitius explicarem. Feci quàm potui diligentissimè,
& fusè quæ de eo mea esset sententia sum exsecutus.
Quod cum ipsi placuisset, eóque spes facta esset posse
& aliis esse usui, disputationem totam aliquanto post

page.notes: Woodcut initial P at left is decorative. Printed text has some blurring at the right margin; "in urbe" and "sententia" readings are approximate. Line "Ac tamctsi" and "satis" read as printed; "ilsiusmodi" possibly misprint for "huiusmodi" and left as printed. Ornamental rule at top is not text. Show-through from the reverse is faint and omitted.
